presentation.label: DISSOLVE
presentation.summary: A glitch delay after the OBNE Parting: chunks of what you play are dropped, smeared into a wash, reversed or dropped an octave.
presentation.overview: A glitch delay after the OBNE Parting: chunks of what you play are dropped, smeared into a wash, reversed or dropped an octave.
highlights: Play a steady beat and listen for the transitions between smear and glitch.
usage: Add Dissolve from the Delay group to a spare patch.
Play a steady beat and listen for the transitions between smear and glitch.
Use the page buttons to reach the remaining controls.

access.location: Delay group in the MS-70CDR effect list, under Dissolve.
steps: Add Dissolve from the Delay group to a spare patch.
Play a steady beat and listen for the transitions between smear and glitch.

controls.name: Chnce
controls.doc: params[5]. Probability an input chunk is dropped before the delay line. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Smear
controls.doc: params[6]. Feedback + diffusion: slapback .. washy near-reverb dissolve. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Gltch
controls.doc: params[7]. Probability a read chunk plays reversed or an octave down. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Mix
controls.doc: Mix default 1 (quiet-safe). The editor materialises patches on load (full-patch send), so audible-on-load no longer needs a hot default. Range 0–100.

limitations: Hardware untested on the original MS-70CDR with OS 2.10.
This build has startup knob initialization disabled. Check saved settings after recalling a patch.

load.conditions: The effect descriptor declares this cost. Audio load on the pedal is unmeasured.

tests.summary: Ziddle passed the loader check and rendered 22,050 stereo frames. The compiled file passed the stock-code scan and MS-70CDR size limits. Hardware untested.
